answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 66 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a summit bet on surviving 66 epochs of grading, and every opal settlement recomputes the sonnet schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 35 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
